tool_audit.command:
/bin/zsh -lc "./run_python - <<'PY'
import app

# Incremental UTF-8 framing and whole-text metrics.
wire = '{\"event\":\"token\",\"text\":\"你\\u2003好\"}\\n{\"event\":\"token\",\"text\":\"\"}\\n{\"event\":\"done\"}\\n'.encode()
p = app.EventStream()
events = []
for byte in wire:
    events.extend(p.feed(bytes([byte])))
assert events == [
    {\"event\": \"token\", \"text\": \"你\\u2003好\"},
    {\"event\": \"token\", \"text\": \"\"},
    {\"event\": \"done\", \"text\": \"你\\u2003好\", \"characters\": 3, \"words\": 2},
]
assert p.state == \"DONE\" and p.buffered_bytes == 0
assert p.finish() == p.finish() == [] and p.feed(b\"\") == []
assert app.text_metrics(\"你\\u2003好\") == {\"characters\": 3, \"words\": 2}

# Multiple complete frames may exceed the per-frame limit in aggregate.
p = app.EventStream(max_buffer=16)
assert len(p.feed(b'{\"event\":\"done\"}\\n' * 100)) == 1

# The limit counts frame bytes, excluding LF, and equality is allowed.
p = app.EventStream(max_buffer=len(b'{\"event\":\"done\"}'))
assert p.feed(b'{\"event\":\"done\"}\\n')[0][\"event\"] == \"done\"
p = app.EventStream(max_buffer=len(b'{\"event\":\"done\"}') - 1)
try:
    p.feed(b'{\"event\":\"done\"}\\n')
except app.StreamError:
    assert p.state == \"FAILED\" and p.buffered_bytes == 0
else:
    raise AssertionError(\"oversized frame accepted\")

# Error is terminal, without a synthetic done event.
p = app.EventStream()
assert p.feed(b'{\"event\":\"error\",\"message\":\"stop\"}\\n') == [
    {\"event\": \"error\", \"message\": \"stop\"}
]
assert p.state == \"ERROR\" and p.finish() == []

# Protocol failures clear buffered input and make the parser unusable.
for frame in (
    b'\\n',
    b'{\"event\":\"token\",\"text\":\"x\",\"event\":\"done\"}\\n',
    b'{\"event\":\"token\",\"text\":1}\\n',
    b'\\xff\\n',
    b'{\"event\":\"token\",\"text\":\"unterminated}\\n',
):
    p = app.EventStream()
    try:
        p.feed(frame)
    except app.StreamError:
        assert p.state == \"FAILED\" and p.buffered_bytes == 0
    else:
        raise AssertionError(f\"invalid frame accepted: {frame"'!r}")
    for operation in (lambda: p.feed(b""), p.finish):
        try:
            operation()
        except app.StreamError:
            pass
        else:
            raise AssertionError("failed parser was reusable")

# EOF while open and data after terminal both fail.
p = app.EventStream()
assert p.feed(b'"'{\"event\":\"token\",\"text\":\"a\"}') == []
assert p.buffered_bytes == len(b'{\"event\":\"token\",\"text\":\"a\"}')
try:
    p.finish()
except app.StreamError:
    assert p.state == \"FAILED\" and p.buffered_bytes == 0
else:
    raise AssertionError(\"premature EOF accepted\")
p = app.EventStream()
try:
    p.feed(b'{\"event\":\"done\"}\\nx')
except app.StreamError:
    assert p.state == \"FAILED\" and p.buffered_bytes == 0
else:
    raise AssertionError(\"trailing bytes accepted\")
print(\"contract checks passed\")
PY
./run_python smoke.py"
